tasks.short: Observe estrus and exercise animals when appropriate

steps.what: Read the actual animal's identity, heat history and existing care or exercise instructions through the herd record's native animal view
inputs: Actual animal identity and existing herd history
outputs: Verified animal context

steps.what: Observe the actual animal's behaviour and physical signs to detect the approach of estrus
inputs: Actual animal and real observation period
outputs: Actual observed signs and uncertainty

steps.what: Assess the actual observed signs and whether exercise is appropriate and necessary under the real animal-care instructions
inputs: Actual observations and applicable care context
outputs: Actual estrus assessment and specified exercise or no-exercise decision

steps.what: Check current animal condition, handling conditions and the exact specified routine exercise before deciding whether it may proceed
inputs: Actual current animal and handling conditions and s3 specified exercise
outputs: Current actual readiness decision for the specified exercise

steps.what: Carry out only the actual appropriate routine exercise covered by current handling readiness, stopping if animal condition changes
inputs: Actual animal and valid current s4 exercise readiness
outputs: Actual exercise and observed animal response

steps.what: Write the actual required heat-observation entry after observation and any exercise, using the existing animal template and verified identity link
inputs: Actual signs, assessment and exercise if actually performed
outputs: Accurate actual animal observation entry

steps.what: Save the completed entry in the same herd record
inputs: Completed actual heat-observation entry
outputs: Stored observation entry

tasks.design: Use {OPS_SYSTEM} animal views and the existing heat-observation template for actual context and record writing. Observation, estrus assessment and any appropriate routine exercise remain actual animal-care work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Animal context and repeated identifying fields can require separate navigation and entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native animal views and identity-linked templates can reduce that clerical work.
tasks.still_hard: Actual signs and an individual animal's response require observation and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise uncertainty or a condition that makes exercise inappropriate.

ambition.what: Support the existing observation and care episode.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: herd records can expose animal history and identity-linked observation fields; detecting estrus and handling animals remain human work.

assumptions: Illustrative episode where actual necessary routine exercise is appropriate; do not extrapolate exercise time to all observations. Existing care staff produce history and instructions; s1 checks them and s2 counts actual observations, not a free sensor feed. No automated estrus inference or treatment is proposed.

S4 is actual current animal-handling readiness, not self-approval of a record. The exact exercise decision exists in s3 first; changes to animal or handling conditions void a1. Any actual veterinary instruction remains with the real veterinarian and is not assumed produced here.

The actual required observation entry is split from physical care in s6. Template savings cover verified identity fields only, not observation meaning. Try native configuration first; existing use yields no new benefit.

Ordinary same-system save share1 represents negligible actual time, fully retained, ungated and with no saving. No insemination, medication, external report or breeding commitment is hidden in it. Shares are illustrative and independent of prompt time priors.
unknowns: Does the actual heat entry already carry animal identity automatically?
How often does an actual observation episode involve appropriate exercise?
research_questions: Observe animal-history lookup, actual observation, care decisions, any exercise and actual record writing separately.

already_counted.description: Actual context checking, observation, assessment, current handling readiness, exercise, observation writing and ordinary save remain in s1-s7.

incremental.description: Maintain animal-view and template links beyond retained case checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact routine exercise specified in s3 for the actual animal under current condition and handling checks in s4; any change voids readiness

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:10*.10+9*.10=1.9 gross less.5 upkeep=1.4. Low: actual animal history is already directly available, so its10 points yield no new gain; identity-linked entry still saves.9, less.5 upkeep=.4. All observation55, assessment10, readiness5, actual exercise10 and save1 remain. An existing-animal-view scenario, unmeasured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide minor animal care and contact veterinarians for serious conditions

steps.what: Read the actual animal's identity, care history and existing permitted minor-care instructions using the native herd view
inputs: Actual animal identity, care history and existing instructions
outputs: Verified animal-care context

steps.what: Observe and assess the actual injury or illness, identify serious signs and decide which immediate minor care is within actual competence and whether veterinary help is required
inputs: Actual animal and clinical signs
outputs: Actual care and veterinary-contact decision with uncertainty

steps.what: Check the current animal condition and handling conditions before deciding whether the exact permitted minor first-aid action can proceed
inputs: Actual current animal and s2 specified permitted minor care
outputs: Current actual readiness for the specified minor-care action

steps.what: Perform only the actual specified appropriate minor first aid within existing competence and instructions
inputs: Actual animal, care materials and valid current s3 readiness
outputs: Actual minor care and observed response

steps.what: Contact the actual veterinarian by telephone for the serious condition, communicate signs and any first aid and clarify the required veterinary attendance or instructions
inputs: Actual serious signs, animal context and any care already performed
outputs: Actual veterinary contact, advice and attendance arrangements

steps.what: Write the actual required care entry with observed signs, first aid actually performed and veterinarian advice actually received, using existing animal identity fields
inputs: Actual observations, care and completed veterinary call
outputs: Accurate actual animal-care entry

steps.what: Save the completed care entry in the same herd record
inputs: Completed actual care entry
outputs: Stored care entry

tasks.design: Use {OPS_SYSTEM} to retrieve existing animal context and prefill verified identity fields in the actual care record. The breeder assesses actual signs, provides only appropriate permitted minor first aid and speaks directly with the veterinarian through {TELEPHONY}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Care history and repeated animal identification may require clerical work around actual care.
tasks.enabler_now: Native herd views and entry fields can reduce that navigation and repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Serious signs, immediate care and veterinary communication remain human responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a condition beyond competence and obtain veterinary help promptly.

ambition.what: Support the existing care and veterinary-contact episode.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: herd views and identity-linked care fields can reduce clerical work; treatment judgement and veterinary care remain with actual people.

assumptions: Representative episode with appropriate minor first aid and serious signs requiring actual veterinary contact; not a measured mix of all injuries. Existing care authors produce history; s1 counts checking it and s2 actual assessment. No free diagnosis or new treatment plan is assumed.

S3 is actual immediate physical care readiness, not an author approving her own record. The exact minor action is specified first. Changes to animal or handling conditions void a1. No prescription, serious-condition treatment or new veterinary order is generated by software; actual later veterinarian treatment is outside this breeder labour denominator and not a claimed saving.

S5 is an actual spoken call, not a written referral or automated message. Advice is only recorded after it is actually received. If a real written request or subsequent treatment action is required, add that actual artefact and distinct authority/action rather than hiding it in the call or save.

S6 splits actual required record writing from care and conversation. Savings cover identity fields only. Native features already in use have no new gain; ordinary same-system save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated. Shares are illustrative and not sized from prompt priors.
unknowns: Which animal-care fields are already native and identity-linked?
Which minor-care instructions and actual competencies apply to the animal?
research_questions: Observe real care, veterinary contact and subsequent required record writing separately, without delaying care for software use.

already_counted.description: Actual care context, assessment, current readiness, first aid, veterinary call, actual entry and ordinary save remain in s1-s7.

incremental.description: Maintain care-history and identity-field links beyond retained case checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact permitted minor first aid specified in s2 for the actual animal under current animal and handling conditions checked in s3; changes void readiness

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:1 history-navigation point plus.9 identity-entry points less.5 upkeep=1.4. Low: identity-linked care fields and direct care-history views already exist and are used, so all98.1 retained points plus the existing1.9 clerical points remain in the actual baseline, with zero new configuration or upkeep. Assessment25, readiness5, actual care20, veterinary call30 and save1 remain in either case. Unmeasured existing-care-record availability case.

tasks.short: Purchase and stock animal feed and medicine supplies

steps.what: Inspect actual feed and medicine stock, expiry, usage and storage conditions and verify current supplier items, prices and any actual veterinary prescribing requirements
inputs: Actual stock, existing use records, supplier catalogue and actual applicable veterinary instructions
outputs: Verified item IDs, quantities, expiry context, prices and actual permitted supply requirements

steps.what: Choose actual needed feed and medicine supplies, quantities and supplier within real budget and veterinary restrictions and map exact items to the purchase form
inputs: Actual stock evidence and verified permitted supply requirements
outputs: Actual selected purchase lines, quantities, supplier and delivery requirements

steps.what: Populate the final proposed purchase order with only the explicitly selected supplier, item IDs, quantities, verified prices and delivery details
inputs: S2 actual selected purchase lines and s1 verified supplier fields
outputs: Exact final proposed order including supplier, lines, quantities, total and delivery destination

steps.what: Review the actual final proposed order and its permitted feed and medicine scope, price and budget and decide whether to authorise that exact purchase
inputs: S3 exact final proposed order and actual purchase authority
outputs: Actual approval or rejection of the exact order

steps.what: Submit only the exact authorised final purchase order to the identified supplier
inputs: Exact final order and valid s4 actual purchasing authority
outputs: Actual order submission and supplier response

steps.what: Receive actual delivered feed and medicines, inspect item identity, quantities, expiry and condition and physically stock them under required storage conditions
inputs: Actual supplier delivery and submitted order
outputs: Actually inspected and stocked supplies with discrepancies

steps.what: Write the actual stock entry after receipt using the native order-linked template, retaining actual batch, expiry, condition and discrepancy checks
inputs: Actual inspected delivery and verified order references
outputs: Accurate actual stock entry

steps.what: Save the completed stock entry in the same stock record
inputs: Completed actual stock entry
outputs: Stored stock entry

tasks.design: Use {PROCUREMENT} to populate actual selected order fields and submit only the final version authorised through the real purchasing route. Keep stock inspection, supply choices and physical stocking with the breeder and use {OPS_SYSTEM} order-linked fields for the actual subsequent stock entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual selected supplier lines and order references may be entered repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native order templates and linked stock fields can populate explicit values deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Medicine restrictions, real demand and delivery condition require actual checks.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise inappropriate supplies, expired deliveries or discrepancies requiring action.

ambition.what: Reduce actual repeated order and stock fields within existing supplies purchasing.

reach.learn: Real budget and permitted purchase authority

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: purchasing forms can populate explicit selected items and stock records can reuse verified order references; supply decisions and receipt inspection remain human work.

assumptions: Representative actual replenishment episode, not automatic medicine selection. Breeder stock inspection and existing supplier catalogue produce input; s1 counts real quantities, item and price checks, s2 real supply decisions and field mapping. Actual veterinary prescribing remains with the veterinarian; no new prescription or uncounted free demand forecast is assumed.

S3 maps actual supplier, item ID, quantity, unit, verified unit price, delivery address and order total. Savings require observed repeated form entry today. Try native purchase templates first; existing automation earns no new runtime saving.

S4 is the actual existing purchasing authority independent of the order author, explicitly retained other-role work. Do not invent a new approver or self-approval. If the real organisation has a different lawful purchasing route, map it before deployment and do not treat an unapproved order as authorised. Final order exists before review; any item, quantity, supplier, total or destination change voids a1 and requires fresh review. Actual submission is its own retained step; its small time yields no saving.

S6 counts real receipt and physical stocking after actual supplier delivery. Supplier fulfilment remains supplier work, not a focal-role saving or free physical labour transfer. S7 is actual stock-record writing, not a concealed invoice approval, payment or formal release. Those actual additional actions need their real authorities if present.

Ordinary same-system stock save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated. Baseline has95 focal points and5 purchasing-authority points; normalise savings to95. Shares are illustrative task effort independent of prompt priors.
unknowns: Which actual order fields are still entered manually?
Who holds real purchasing authority and which medicine requirements apply?
Are stock fields actually linked to orders already?
research_questions: Observe an actual feed or medicine purchase from stock inspection to physical stocking, counting purchasing-authority time separately.

already_counted.description: Actual stock and source checks, supply decisions, retained submission, physical receipt/stocking, stock entry and ordinary save total78.6 focal points out of95.
Actual purchasing authority review retains5 points, equivalent to5/95 of focal baseline, with no saving claimed.

incremental.description: Maintain supplier-item and order-to-stock mappings beyond retained purchase and receipt checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final order from s3 including supplier, all item IDs and quantities, prices, total and delivery destination; any change requires renewed s4 approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:(15 order fields+14*.10 stock references)/95*100-3=14.263, rounded down14.2. Low: supplier medicine catalogue identifiers are incompatible for9 of15 order-entry points, retaining that entry manually;6 mapped order points+1.4 stock-reference points save,7.4/95*100-3=4.789, rounded down4.7. All source15, supply judgement15, actual independent review5, send1, physical stocking34 and save1 remain. A supplier-item mapping case, unmeasured.

tasks.short: Record animal weights, growth patterns and diets

steps.what: Identify the actual animal, obtain its real weight and date from the weighing process and capture actual diet, units and relevant existing measurements, checking identity and source context
inputs: Actual animal, actual weighing equipment and real diet observations or feed records
outputs: Verified animal ID, actual weight/date/unit, diet and earlier readings

steps.what: Populate the unsaved animal-characteristics form with actual verified scale and diet values under explicit animal, date and unit mapping
inputs: S1 actual verified animal, weight/date/unit and diet fields
outputs: Proposed characteristics fields and missing-source exceptions

steps.what: Calculate the explicitly defined weight change and interval growth values and plot actual recorded weights over time, leaving missing or incomparable intervals flagged
inputs: Actual verified prior and current weights, dates, units and explicit growth formula
outputs: Actual recorded growth values and plot with data-gap flags

steps.what: Check the complete animal entry against actual weights, dates and diet, correct identity or unit errors and write the actual contextual note without inferring a diagnosis
inputs: Actual original values, proposed entry and explicit growth calculations
outputs: Accurate actual animal-characteristics entry with context and gaps

steps.what: Save the completed characteristics entry in the same animal record
inputs: Checked actual characteristics entry
outputs: Stored actual animal characteristics

tasks.design: Use {OPS_SYSTEM} to populate actual verified characteristics from {OTHER}, the weighing and feed-record tools, and calculate explicitly defined growth values. The breeder captures real source values and checks identity, units, diet context and the complete entry before ordinary saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual animal values may be retyped and growth intervals calculated separately.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field mappings and explicit weight/date arithmetic can perform that repeated work.
tasks.still_hard: Actual animal identity, real diet and valid measurements require source checks.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an implausible reading or misleading growth pattern and investigate rather than treating it as a diagnosis.

ambition.what: Reduce demonstrated repeated characteristics entry and arithmetic.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: herd records can map explicit weights and diet fields and compute stated growth arithmetic while actual capture and checking remain human work.

assumptions: Conditional on observed manual entry and separate growth arithmetic today. Actual breeder weighing and diet observation produce source values, all counted in s1, including animal identification, dates, units and earlier-reading retrieval. No free clean animal feed, sensor deployment or supplier capture is assumed.

S2 requires animal ID, reading date/time, weight and unit, actual diet identifier/amount/unit where recorded and source reference. Missing export fields remain manually captured and entered. S3 uses the breeder's explicit weight-change/elapsed-time formula on comparable values only; it does not select breeding animals, diagnose illness or prescribe diets.

Try native herd forms and growth charts first; already automated capture and calculations have zero new human saving. S4 retains complete original-value checking, manual exceptions and actual contextual writing; no model is required for arithmetic.

Actual record writing is separate from physical source capture. No insemination, medication, diet-change order, external report or formal animal movement is hidden in ordinary saving. The same-system save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated with no author self-approval. Shares are illustrative task work independent of prompt priors.
unknowns: Which actual weight and diet fields are still typed by hand?
Do weighing outputs carry reliable animal identity and dates?
research_questions: Observe real weighing and diet recording, then time repeated entry, explicit calculations and complete checking separately.

already_counted.description: Actual animal identification, physical weight and diet capture, complete checking and contextual writing plus ordinary save remain in s1, s4 and s5.

incremental.description: Maintain scale/diet field mappings and explicit growth-formula checks beyond retained per-animal validation.

Low: scale outputs lack reliable animal identity, so all25 entry points remain manual; once verified readings are entered, the15 explicitly defined growth-calculation points still save, less4 upkeep=11. All35 physical/source-capture,24 checking/context and1 save points remain. An actual animal-ID export constraint, unmeasured; existing native charts earn zero new benefit instead.
